verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform for AI sandboxes, agent hosting and a model gateway, so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no statement about model training, training opt-outs or data-use policy. Sandbox egress allowlists that prevent data exfiltration are a related network control, not a training-data guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
